en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prohibited earnings would manifest (show their bad effect) inteself in the offsprings’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ahmad has narrated from ibn Faddal from ibn Bukayr from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The effects of unlawful earning shows up in one’s offspring.’”
